gaps.explanation: Gap 3,352,979 (statement 31,323,564 p4, schedule 27,970,585). (1) Missing fund column: the governmental funds statement (p4) prints an 'Other Governmental Funds' column (Total revenues 3,872,178) with no schedule; none of its lines are in detail. Added below: Property taxes 657,202, Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 183,368, Sales tax 436,272, Charges for services 683,749, Donations 52,360, Grants 348,498, Investment earnings 43,264, Miscellaneous 1,467,465 = 3,872,178. (2) Different basis: detail for the five major funds is the budget-basis budget-to-actual schedules (pp8-12), whose printed revenue totals differ from the GAAP statement columns (p4): General 11,509,357 vs 10,833,930 (+675,427), Streets/Engineering 7,321,818 vs 7,318,191 (+3,627), Sales Tax 6,248,202 vs 6,358,957 (-110,755), 1/2 Cent Sales Tax 2,877,957 vs 2,927,057 (-49,100), ARP Act 13,251 vs 13,251 (0); net +519,199. Arithmetic: 27,970,585 + 3,872,178 = 31,842,763 = 31,323,564 + 519,199. The remaining 519,199 (schedule above) is budget basis vs GAAP and stays.

gaps.explanation: Gap 4,332,426 (statement 57,850,793 p4, schedule 53,518,367). (1) Missing fund column: Other Governmental Funds column (p4) Total expenditures 3,803,358 = Public safety 1,468,130 + Public works 332,443 + Cultural and recreation 3,495 + Community development 475,426 + Capital outlay 249,790 + Principal 910,000 + Interest and fiscal charges 364,074; added below. (2) Different basis (budget-basis schedules vs GAAP columns): General budget 39,677,328 (p8) vs GAAP 39,591,660 (+85,668; e.g. GAAP prints Principal on leases 92,728 and Interest on leases 27,959 that the budget schedule does not, and different function amounts); Streets/Engineering budget 13,212,835 (p9) vs GAAP 13,227,571 (-14,736); 1/2 Cent Sales Tax budget 628,204 (p11; Principal printed '-' actual, budget 600,000) vs GAAP 1,228,204 (Principal 600,000 + Interest 628,204) (-600,000); net -529,068. Arithmetic: 53,518,367 + 3,803,358 = 57,321,725 = 57,850,793 - 529,068. The remaining 529,068 (schedule short) is budget basis vs GAAP and stays.

gaps.explanation: Gap 1,165,749 (statement 29,992,297 p4, schedule 28,826,548 = General 24,534,727 + Streets/Engineering 4,291,821). (1) Missing fund column: Other Governmental Funds 'Transfer in' 685,749 (p4), added below. (2) Different basis: the General Fund budget schedule (p8) prints one net row 'Transfers in (out), net' 24,534,727, while the GAAP statement General Fund column prints Transfer in 25,014,728 and Transfers out (480,000) gross (25,014,728 - 480,000 = 24,534,728; 1 rounding); Streets budget 4,291,821 vs GAAP 4,291,820 (rounding). Arithmetic: 28,826,548 + 685,749 = 29,512,297 = 29,992,297 - 480,000. The remaining 480,000 is the General Fund's net vs gross presentation and stays.

gaps.explanation: Gap 5,974,514 (statement 25,681,857 p4, schedule 19,707,343 = Sales Tax (7,507,338) p10 + 1/2 Cent Sales Tax (12,200,005) p11). (1) Missing fund column: Other Governmental Funds 'Transfers out' (5,494,514) (p4), added below. (2) Different basis: the GAAP statement General Fund column prints Transfers out (480,000), which the General Fund budget schedule (p8) nets into 'Transfers in (out), net' 24,534,727 (recorded as a transfer in). Arithmetic: 19,707,343 + 5,494,514 = 25,201,857 = 25,681,857 - 480,000. The remaining 480,000 is the General Fund's net presentation and stays.
